title: Generate and validate PBR materials
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for generate and validate pbr materials.

ordered_stages.action: Define texel density, channels, color space, tiling, packing, and engine shader target.
Generate albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, AO, and height candidates.
Remove baked lighting, correct normal orientation, clamp values, and repair seams.
Resize and pack channels without overwriting source maps.
Render neutral-light turntables and inspect at gameplay distances.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
Maps use the expected color spaces and channel conventions.
Seams, tiling, energy response, texel density, and memory budget pass.

fallbacks: Bake a conventional material in Blender.
Ship a neutral verified material while generated maps remain under review.
